transcript.text: Alright everyone, I've got the draft plan for the October platform maintenance train ready for review. Before I publish it, I want to walk through the standard review process — backend, infrastructure, QA, and release coordination, in that order — so each of you can check the dates and commitments for your area. Here's what's currently on the draft: Week 1 (Oct 6-10) is CI-runner cleanup, Week 2 (Oct 13-17) is crypto-dependency upgrade, Week 3 (Oct 20-24) is database-indexing cleanup, and Week 4 (Oct 27-31) is certificate automation. Let's start with backend — any concerns with these assignments?

transcript.text: I have a concern with the crypto-dependency upgrade placement. While tracing a separate SDK upgrade yesterday, I confirmed that the payment service still imports the old crypto library. The replacement must run in week 1 so downstream SDK validation can begin before the train ends. I haven't updated the maintenance ticket yet because the dependency confirmation came from a local build completed after the ticket was last reviewed.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag something for the infrastructure review. During a cloud-billing reconciliation this morning, I found that exactly 14 idle CI runners are still incurring charges and can be retired safely in week 4 after the active build queues are drained. The runner inventory hasn't been corrected yet because the billing investigation is still open. This is relevant to the CI-runner cleanup scheduling — if that workstream moves to week 1 as Ravi's crypto dependency concern might require, we'd need to account for the fact that the safe retirement window for those 14 runners is week 4, not week 1.
